definitions.content:
Additional device (ancillary device) repeating the indication of the indicating device.

- significant faults; and/or

Facility incorporated in an electronic automatic level gauge that enables:

- incorrect functioning of a specific device of the ALG; and/or

- disturbed communication between specific devices of the ALG

to be detected and acted upon.

notes.content: "Acted upon" refers to any adequate response by the ALG (luminous signal, acoustic signal, prevention of the measurement process, etc.).
